senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָרַם II) [rubbed, bright, cmp. Lat. tritus,] prudent, deliberate, wise; (in an evil sense) subtle, cunning.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 17a:9">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם יהא אדם ע׳ ביראה</he> man should always be deliberate in the fear of the Lord (consider in what manner he can best serve the Lord).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>רשע ע׳</he> a wicked man that is subtle, expl.
<cite ref="Sotah 21b:6">ib. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>זה המטעים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="I00609"><he>טָעַם</he></cite>; Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 6">Mishp. 6</cite>. Sot. l. c. <he>במי שמשים עצמו ע׳</he> Var. in Rashi, v. <cite ref="P01326">next w.</cite>; a. fr.—Pesik. Shimʿu, p. 118ᵇ, sq. (in Chald. dict.) <he>לית עיסקא דע׳ מהלך עם שטיא</he> the sane has no business to walk with the fool; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 265:2">Yalk. Jer. 265</cite> <he>דעָרִים</he>).—Pl. <he>עֲרוּמִים</he>, <he>עֲרוּמִין</he>.

<cite ref="Chullin 5b:5">Ḥull. 5ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 36:7">Ps. XXXVI, 7</cite>) <he>אלו בני אדם שהן ע׳ בדעת וכ׳</he> that means those men who are clever in knowledge and yet conduct themselves humbly like a domestic animal; a. e.
